notes.title: Hotfixc 0.4.4g
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed more bugs related to dungeon rooms, particularly ones blocking progress
[*] Missions you've already done are now greyed out on the map
[*] The health drain stratagem doesn't kill you anymore, it just reduces you to 1 heart
[*] Unused potions are now automatically used to prevent a game over, leaving you with 1 heart instead of dying with your last character. You only get one heart instead of the full heal, however.
[*] Crystal beams in dungeons are now visible on the map so it's easier to find where the crystals are
[/list]

notes.title: Marmoreal Update 0.4.4 is now live! New map layout and Custom Expeditions!
notes.content:
[h1]Marmoreal 0.4.4 is now live![/h1]
-Revamped the campaign map to integrate the dungeons into the story instead of being completely disconnected modes.
-Added a Custom Expedition mode, marked by the two crossed swords in the UI. This mode lets you select what regions can show up in the expedition. You can have an entire mega-dungeon with Castles, Forests, Mountains and everything! You can also select custom mutators like instant death, no revives, constant damage and double damage.
-Added two new Survival maps, the Ruins and the Trial by Fire.
-Added a new Blueflame Ember for Fiera.

[b]Notice for players:[/b]
Since the update revamps the campaign map, existing savefiles can end up having the map be a little wonky. The save is fine, nothing's lost, but you may need to complete the new mini-missions to access some missions you've already unlocked before.

notes.content:
The first major update is out! The Dungeons update!

-Wisp enemy faction added to the Forest dungeon

notes.title: Marmoreal Update 0.4.1
notes.content:
Marmoreal Update 0.4.1 is now live!

-New Buckler Shield for Vania, complete with a new Parrying system that replaces Dodging when wielding a Buckler
-New Blunderbuss (Rifle variant) weapon for Octavia, a short-range wide-spread version of the Rifle
-New Fire Rune for Arcana, granting fireball abilities like Fiera's base Embers have
-Dungeons are now more evenly spread throughout level brackets, with starting levels at 3, 5, 8 and 10 instead of 1, 5 and 10. (Castle Dungeon got raised and Mountain Dungeon lowered)
-Balance adjustments and bugfixes

notes.title: Marmoreal releases on August 26!
notes.content:
Big news! Marmoreal is launching into Early Access on Steam on August 26th!

It’s a challenging Diablo-like with bullet hell elements and cute anime girls, where you can swap between party members on the fly, each with their own playstyle. There are six playable characters, split between two campaigns - The mages of The Arcanum and the warriors of Melkirion. It features animated cutscenes with charming characters and a mix of humorous and serious scenes.

The Early Access version at launch will have about 4-6 hours of story content, and several dungeons for the rougelite-ish side content.
